payload.title: Colors follow the system light or dark setting
payload.description:
As the student, I want the app to match my system's light or dark mode without a toggle in the main UI.

Feature: System color mode
  Scenario: Dark system preference
    Given the system prefers a dark color scheme
    When I open the IDE
    Then the interface uses the dark palette
  Scenario: The system preference changes while open
    Given the IDE is open in light mode following the system
    When the system switches to dark
    Then the interface switches to the dark palette without a reload
